statement: A deterministic versioned opportunity calculator emits reproducible unit-checked analytical bounds, assumptions, sensitivity ranges, and uncertainty for the sealed fixture set; every admitted quantity, including zero and fractional average lookup cardinality, contributes dimensionally according to its declared units; unsupported or dimensionally inconsistent inputs fail closed; and no output is labeled as a measured claim.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not seal this Quest until comparative-efficiency-evidence-contract is terminal.
Calculator output is always analytical_bound and may never be presented as measured throughput, latency, capacity, scale, or infrastructure cost.
Every input and output carries explicit units, formula version, assumptions, and sensitivity bounds; unsupported or dimensionally inconsistent values fail closed.
